name: gym-workout-tracker
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for the GYM Workout Tracker web app.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
